units.source_text: 这时候少将因为她那当阿阇梨的哥哥跟僧都同来，她正在自己房间里和他谈话。

en.t: At that moment, because her brother, the Ajari, had come with the Sozu, the Shosho was talking with him in her own room.

units.source_text: 左卫门也在招待一个相识的人。

en.t: Saemon, too, was entertaining an acquaintance.

units.source_text: 住在这山乡里的人，难得遇见熟人来到，

en.t: For people living in this mountain village, it was rare to have familiar visitors arrive,

units.source_text: 所以都很兴奋，正在热心地同他们共谈家常琐事。

en.t: so everyone was excited and eagerly chatting with them about ordinary household matters.

units.source_text: 浮舟身边只有可莫姬一人。

en.t: Only Lady Komo was at Ukifune's side.

units.source_text: 她跑到少将那里，将此事报告了她。

en.t: She ran to the Shosho and reported the matter to her.

units.source_text: 少将吃了一惊，连忙跑过来看，

en.t: The Shosho was startled and hurried over to see,

units.source_text: 但见僧都正在脱下自己的袈裟来，披在浮舟身上，说道：“以此略表仪式。”

en.t: only to find the Sozu taking off his own robe and draping it over Ukifune, saying that this would serve as a token of the rite.

units.source_text: 又对浮舟说道：“请小姐对着父母所在的方向三拜！”

en.t: Then he told Ukifune to bow three times toward the direction where her parents were.

units.source_text: 浮舟不知道母亲所在之处是哪一个方向，

en.t: Ukifune did not know in which direction her mother was,

units.source_text: 悲痛难忍，竟自哭泣起来。

en.t: and, unable to bear her grief, she began to weep.

units.source_text: 少将说：“哎呀！

en.t: The Shosho cried out in dismay.

units.source_text: 真想不到啊！

en.t: This is truly beyond anything I imagined.

units.source_text: 怎么干这没道理的事呀！

en.t: How could anyone do something so unreasonable?

units.source_text: 师父回家时定要大骂了！”

en.t: When our master comes home, he is certain to scold us terribly.

units.source_text: 僧都认为事已至此，

en.t: The Sozu felt that, since matters had already come this far,

units.source_text: 这种话反而使她心迷意乱，甚不应该，

en.t: such words would only throw her heart into confusion and were quite improper,

units.source_text: 便斥责少将。

en.t: so he rebuked the Shosho.

units.source_text: 少将终于不敢走过来干涉。

en.t: In the end, the Shosho did not dare come closer to interfere.

units.source_text: 僧都念偈语道：“流转三界中，恩爱不能断。

en.t: The Sozu chanted a verse: while one wanders through the three realms, bonds of love and obligation cannot be cut off.

units.source_text: 弃恩入无为，真实报恩者。”

en.t: One who abandons those bonds and enters nonaction is the one who truly repays kindness.

units.source_text: 浮舟听了，想起我今已断恩爱，

en.t: Hearing this, Ukifune thought that she had now severed all bonds of love and obligation,

units.source_text: 毕竟不胜悲伤。

en.t: and in the end she could not bear her sorrow.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨替她剪发，很费手续。

en.t: The Ajari cut her hair, a process that took considerable care and ceremony.

units.source_text: 剪罢，他说：“以后请尼僧们慢慢地修整吧。”

en.t: When he had finished cutting it, he said that the nuns should gradually trim it properly afterward.

units.source_text: 额发则由僧都亲自剪落。

en.t: The hair over her forehead was cut off by the Sozu himself.

units.source_text: 落发既毕，他对浮舟说道：“你这美丽的容貌，今已改变，

en.t: When the tonsure was complete, he told Ukifune that her beautiful appearance had now changed.

units.source_text: 千万不可后悔啊！”

en.t: You must on no account regret it.

units.source_text: 便向她述说尊贵的教义。

en.t: Then he explained the noble teachings to her.

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“这件不易办到的事，大家都阻止我，

en.t: Ukifune thought that this difficult thing had been something everyone tried to prevent her from doing,

units.source_text: 今天幸得办成，实甚可喜。”

en.t: and that she was truly glad to have been fortunate enough to accomplish it today.

units.source_text: 她觉得只要能够如此，今后便有做人的意义了。

en.t: She felt that, as long as she could live this way, her life from now on would have meaning.
